# Recorded unauthenticated access fixtures

The three HTTP 401 responses and their hashed manifests were captured from CFBD and The Odds API on October 14, 2026. No API credentials were present. These files contain access-error responses only, not football data or historical sportsbook prices.

Successful payload shapes elsewhere in the tests are explicitly constructed contract fixtures. They are not recorded provider successes and are never counted as empirical performance evidence.
